The '''Lamman system''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[trailing]] direction from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']]<ref name="Lessons" /> [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[TK-575]], a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who was in service<ref name="Lessons" /> at one point between approximately [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]] and [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Dates">{{FFG|story=Lessons from the Past|book=Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|text=''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook}}, which establishes that [[TK-575]] was in service "a little over four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] ago," is set during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], which corresponds to some point between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> once served in the Lamman system. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that was fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="Lessons" /> in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]&ndash;[[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> a mission report mentioning the [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] service in the system had come to rest in the [[Phelar University Archive|Archive]] of [[Phelar University]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="Lessons" />

{{RPG|"[[Lessons from the Past]]"}}
At one point during that conflict, a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals researching TK-575 in the Archive discovered the mission report.<ref name="Lessons" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Lamman system was mentioned in "[[Lessons from the Past]]," a [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying]] adventure included in the [[2015]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]] system. In the adventure, the player characters can optionally discover pieces of information mentioning the system. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="Lessons" />
